features.statement: Palette is built on dark green and teal accents with a white page background, rather than a saturated orange or red.
Base text color is a green-tinted near-black rather than neutral gray.
Section headings are uppercase, letter-spaced, bold sans-serif, sitting above a thick dark rule.
Dates are set in small uppercase letter-spaced text.
Typography pairs a system sans-serif stack with Georgia serif, with roomy body line-height around 1.5.
Navigation links are small, bold and right-aligned in a compact top bar rather than a separate large row.
Hero photo bleeds to the left edge beside a light gray text panel holding the headline, instead of a dark caption overlay.
Lower content is stacked as full-width bands alternating white and light gray, not side-by-side cards.
Content sits in a narrower centered column with generous margins, using CSS grid alongside flex.
'See all' links with a → arrow sit at the right of the section header row.
Read-more links are separate underlined green links placed below the headline, not inline.
Search is a white boxed input with a magnifier icon image, and the signup is a button only.
Video block uses a large thumbnail with the title overlaid near the bottom player controls and a separate list.
Social links pair icons with text labels, and partner logos are shown large with descriptive alt text.
Footer sits on light gray with dark underlined links.
Surfaces are flat, with no box shadows, almost no gradients, and only small rounded corners on a few controls.
Empty states use an italic serif placeholder line such as a 'no upcoming items' message.
Heading hierarchy nests article titles as h3 under section h2s, with no h1 and link text inside h2s.
Markup is minimal: no external scripts or stylesheets, one style block, few classes and a bare head with only charset and viewport.
Icons and video thumbnails are real img elements, and some ARIA attributes are used.
Page title is a short plain brand name with no trailing separators.
